question: Seven people A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). D is sitting second to the left of F. A is sitting third to the right of B. C is sitting to the immediate right of D. Only two people are sitting between F and G. How many people are sitting between C and G when counted from the left of G?
